title: HVAC Plan Studio - Patternmaker's Layout Table

narrative.northStar: HVAC Plan Studio feels like a patternmaker's working layout table: measured, physical, quiet, and ready for exact drafting.
narrative.workspace: Draw & Detail is the drafting workspace. Redline remains an internal workspace within HVAC Plan Studio.
narrative.planAuthority: The source plan is authoritative pure white. Material texture belongs to surrounding chrome only.
narrative.changeBoundary: This visual system does not change workflows, gestures, placement, layers, or the data model.

Kraft.role: Product identity bar, reference tabs, and warm structural fields

Ledger Paper.role: Tool tray, inspector, traveler, menus, and readable chrome

Plan White.role: Untinted and untextured source plan/PDF surface

Graphite.role: Primary text, rules, icons, and working marks

Prussian Blue.role: Active tool, current workspace, primary action, links, and focus

Brick Red.role: Redline identity, correction marks, and destructive emphasis

Aged Zinc.role: Command rail, hardware edges, dividers, and inactive controls

Success.role: Saved, checked, connected, and ready states

display.use: Brand, headings, tools, workflow labels, buttons, tabs, and short status stamps

body.use: Instructions, descriptions, form labels, help, and notes

technical.use: Dimensions, scale, coordinates, identifiers, airflow values, and counts

kraft.use: 52px identity bar, reference tabs, and small label fields

agedZinc.use: Command rail, hardware edges, and separators

ledgerPaper.use: Tool tray, inspector, bottom traveler, and menus

materials.planRule: Never apply a material asset, tint, filter, blend mode, opacity wash, or off-white color to the plan/PDF.

layout.desktopRows: 52px identity bar, minmax(0, 1fr) workspace, 76px bottom traveler, 34px status strip
layout.desktopWorkspace: 58px command rail, 224px tool tray, minmax(0, 1fr) plan, 304px inspector
layout.compact: Reduce gaps and supporting chrome before constraining the plan; drawerize the tray or inspector when both no longer fit.
layout.tabletMobile: Plan-first view with tray and inspector drawers plus a horizontal command rail with 49px minimum targets.
layout.responsiveGuardrail: Opening a drawer does not alter the current tool, selection, placement state, workflow, or plan viewport.

layerOrder: HVAC runs, symbols, fitting previews, and T/Y tools
Existing selection handles and temporary interaction affordances

shape.activeRule: 2px inset Prussian Blue plus a text label and pressed/current attribute
shape.depth: Physical inset and 1-2px raised edges; restrained drawer and modal separation only
shape.measure: Regular low-contrast rule marks outside the source plan

motion.properties: Opacity, color, border, and up to 1px translation
motion.reducedMotion: Remove nonessential transition and animation while preserving every state cue

accessibility.focus: 2px Prussian Blue outline with 2px offset, visible on kraft, ledger, zinc, and white
accessibility.state: Color is never the sole cue; pair it with text and an icon, rule, underline, check, or position marker.
accessibility.mobileTargets: Horizontal command rail controls are at least 49px in both axes.

components.name: Kraft Identity Bar
components.description: A 52px product bar that keeps HVAC Plan Studio and the Draw & Detail workspace distinct.
components.html:

components.css: :host{display:block;color:#2B2B28;font-family:Geist Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}.pm-identity{box-sizing:border-box;height:52px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid #8f846b;border-radius:2px;background-color:#D8C49A;background-image:url('/materials/pattern-kraft-fiber.webp');box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.42),inset 0 -2px rgba(43,43,40,.2)}.pm-brand{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px}.pm-brand strong,.pm-brand span,.pm-job span,.pm-identity button{font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif}.pm-brand strong{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em}.pm-brand span{padding-left:12px;border-left:1px solid rgba(43,43,40,.42);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase}.pm-job{margin-left:auto;display:grid;line-height:1}.pm-job span{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}.pm-job b{margin-top:3px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600}.pm-identity button{min-height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid #2B2B28;border-radius:2px;color:#2B2B28;background:#F7F4EA;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;transition:background-color 170ms ease-out,transform 170ms ease-out}.pm-identity button:hover{background:#FFFFFF;transform:translateY(-1px)}.pm-identity button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #28527A;outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.pm-identity button{transition:none}}

components.name: Measured Command Rail
components.description: A 58px zinc workspace rail that becomes horizontal with 49px targets on tablet and mobile.
components.css: :host{display:block;font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif}.pm-rail{box-sizing:border-box;width:58px;display:grid;align-content:start;gap:2px;padding:5px;border:1px solid #777b76;border-radius:2px;background-color:#AEB1AA;background-image:url('/materials/pattern-aged-zinc.webp');box-shadow:inset 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45),inset -2px 0 rgba(43,43,40,.18)}.pm-rail button{position:relative;min-width:46px;min-height:46px;display:grid;place-items:center;gap:1px;padding:3px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:2px;color:#2B2B28;background:rgba(247,244,234,.24);font:600 10px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.035em;transition:background-color 170ms ease-out,box-shadow 170ms ease-out}.pm-rail button span{font:700 15px Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace}.pm-rail button[aria-current=page]{border-color:#2B2B28;background:#F7F4EA;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 #28527A}.pm-rail button[aria-current=page] b:after{content:' current';position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)}.pm-rail button:hover{background:#FFFFFF}.pm-rail button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #28527A;outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:780px){.pm-rail{width:100%;height:49px;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:minmax(49px,1fr);align-content:stretch;padding:0;overflow-x:auto}.pm-rail button{min-width:49px;min-height:49px}.pm-rail button[aria-current=page]{box-shadow:inset 0 -3px #28527A}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.pm-rail button{transition:none}}

components.name: Ledger Tool Tray
components.description: A 224px ledger sheet for the current workspace tools; selected tools keep a label and gain an inset rule.
components.html: Draw toolsDraw & Detail
components.css: :host{display:block;color:#2B2B28;font-family:Geist Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}.pm-tray{box-sizing:border-box;width:224px;padding:12px 10px;border:1px solid #8c8e89;border-radius:3px;background-color:#F7F4EA;background-image:url('/materials/pattern-ledger-paper.webp');box-shadow:inset 0 1px #FFFFFF,inset -2px 0 rgba(43,43,40,.12)}.pm-tray header{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;margin:0 2px 8px;padding-bottom:7px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(43,43,40,.42)}.pm-tray header span{font:700 15px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase}.pm-tray header small{font:500 9px Geist Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}.pm-tray button{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:38px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid transparent;border-bottom-color:rgba(43,43,40,.2);border-radius:2px;color:#2B2B28;background:transparent;text-align:left;transition:background-color 170ms ease-out,box-shadow 170ms ease-out}.pm-tray button i{width:20px;color:#2B2B28;font:700 14px Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace;font-style:normal;text-align:center}.pm-tray button b{font:700 13px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.025em}.pm-tray kbd{margin-left:auto;font:600 10px Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace}.pm-tray button[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:#7d817c;background:#FFFFFF;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 #28527A}.pm-tray button[aria-pressed=true] b:after{content:' - selected';font:500 9px Geist Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}.pm-tray button:hover{background:#FFFFFF}.pm-tray button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #28527A;outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.pm-tray button{transition:none}}

components.name: Authoritative Plan Stack
components.description: A pure-white source plan with Redline above it and HVAC runs, symbols, and T/Y tools above Redline.
components.css: :host{display:block;color:#2B2B28;font-family:Geist Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}.pm-plan{box-sizing:border-box;width:330px;margin:0;padding:7px;border:1px solid #777b76;border-radius:3px;background-color:#AEB1AA;background-image:url('/materials/pattern-aged-zinc.webp');box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.48),inset 0 -2px rgba(43,43,40,.2)}.pm-plan-white{position:relative;height:190px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #2B2B28;border-radius:2px;background:#FFFFFF}.pm-source{position:absolute;z-index:1;background:#d7d7d3}.pm-source-a{left:24px;top:40px;width:250px;height:1px;box-shadow:0 58px #d7d7d3,0 112px #d7d7d3}.pm-source-b{left:80px;top:18px;width:1px;height:145px;box-shadow:118px 0 #d7d7d3}.pm-redline{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:42px;top:72px;width:175px;height:48px;border:2px dashed #A84537;border-radius:2px;transform:rotate(-2deg)}.pm-hvac{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:34px;top:94px;width:238px;height:5px;background:#28527A;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #FFFFFF,0 0 0 2px #28527A;transform:rotate(4deg);transform-origin:left center}.pm-ty{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:176px;top:77px;width:24px;height:24px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:2px solid #28527A;border-radius:2px;color:#28527A;background:#FFFFFF;font:800 13px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif}.pm-plan figcaption{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 2px 0;font-size:9px}.pm-plan figcaption span,.pm-plan figcaption strong{padding-left:7px;border-left:3px solid #2B2B28}.pm-plan figcaption span:nth-child(2){border-color:#A84537}.pm-plan figcaption strong{border-color:#28527A;font-weight:700}

components.name: Technical Input
components.description: A squared measured field with a mono value, visible focus, and written guidance.
components.css: :host{display:block;color:#2B2B28;font-family:Geist Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}.pm-field{box-sizing:border-box;width:190px;display:grid;gap:4px;padding:10px;border:1px solid #AEB1AA;border-radius:3px;background:#F7F4EA;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #FFFFFF}.pm-field>span{font:700 12px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.045em;text-transform:uppercase}.pm-field input{box-sizing:border-box;height:34px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid #6d6e6a;border-radius:2px;color:#2B2B28;background:#FFFFFF;font:600 12px Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace;transition:border-color 170ms ease-out,box-shadow 170ms ease-out}.pm-field input:hover{border-color:#2B2B28}.pm-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #28527A;outline-offset:2px}.pm-field small{font:500 10px Geist Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.pm-field input{transition:none}}

components.css: :host{display:block;color:#2B2B28;font-family:Geist Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}.pm-inspector{box-sizing:border-box;width:304px;padding:13px;border:1px solid #8c8e89;border-radius:3px;background-color:#F7F4EA;background-image:url('/materials/pattern-ledger-paper.webp');box-shadow:inset 0 1px #FFFFFF,inset 2px 0 rgba(43,43,40,.1)}.pm-inspector header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(43,43,40,.48)}.pm-inspector header span{font:700 15px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.035em;text-transform:uppercase}.pm-inspector header small{font:600 10px Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace}.pm-inspector dl{margin:8px 0}.pm-inspector dl div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px;padding:7px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(43,43,40,.18)}.pm-inspector dt{font:600 11px Geist Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}.pm-inspector dd{margin:0;font:600 11px Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace}.pm-warning{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 0;padding:8px;border:1px solid #8A5E23;border-left-width:4px;border-radius:2px;background:#FFFFFF;font-size:10px;line-height:1.35}.pm-warning>b{flex:0 0 18px;height:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #8A5E23;border-radius:2px;color:#8A5E23;font:800 12px Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace}.pm-warning strong{display:block;color:#8A5E23;font:700 12px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}

components.name: Drafting Actions
components.description: Direct, squared actions for existing drafting and internal Redline tools.
components.css: :host{display:block;font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif}.pm-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;padding:10px;border:1px solid #AEB1AA;border-radius:3px;background:#F7F4EA}.pm-actions button{min-height:34px;padding:0 11px;border-radius:2px;font:700 12px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.035em;cursor:pointer;transition:filter 170ms ease-out,transform 170ms ease-out}.pm-primary{border:1px solid #183d60;color:#FFFFFF;background:#28527A;box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.22),0 2px 0 #183d60}.pm-redline-action{border:1px solid #7f2e25;color:#FFFFFF;background:#A84537;box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.2),0 2px 0 #7f2e25}.pm-redline-action span{margin-right:5px;padding-right:5px;border-right:1px solid currentColor;font-family:Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace}.pm-secondary{border:1px solid #656762;color:#2B2B28;background:#FFFFFF;box-shadow:0 2px 0 #AEB1AA}.pm-actions button:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px)}.pm-actions button:active{transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:none}.pm-actions button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #28527A;outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.pm-actions button{transition:none}}

components.css: :host{display:block;color:#2B2B28;font-family:Geist Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}.pm-traveler{box-sizing:border-box;height:76px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:13px 15px;border:1px solid #8c8e89;border-radius:3px;background-color:#F7F4EA;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(43,43,40,.24) 0 1px,transparent 1px 12px),url('/materials/pattern-ledger-paper.webp');background-size:auto 6px,auto;background-repeat:repeat-x,repeat;background-position:left top,left top;box-shadow:inset 0 2px #FFFFFF}.pm-traveler>div{display:grid;min-width:135px}.pm-traveler>div span{font:600 10px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}.pm-traveler>div strong{font:800 17px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif}.pm-traveler p{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin:0;padding-left:17px;border-left:1px solid #AEB1AA;font-size:11px}.pm-traveler p b{width:22px;height:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #8A5E23;border-radius:2px;color:#8A5E23;font:700 11px Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace}.pm-traveler button{margin-left:auto;min-height:34px;padding:0 13px;border:1px solid #183d60;border-radius:2px;color:#FFFFFF;background:#28527A;box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.22),0 2px 0 #183d60;font:700 12px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;transition:filter 170ms ease-out,transform 170ms ease-out}.pm-traveler button:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px)}.pm-traveler button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #28527A;outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.pm-traveler button{transition:none}}

components.name: Zinc Status Strip

components.css: :host{display:block;color:#2B2B28;font-family:Geist Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}.pm-status{box-sizing:border-box;height:34px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid #777b76;border-radius:2px;background-color:#AEB1AA;background-image:url('/materials/pattern-aged-zinc.webp');box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.45);font:600 9px Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace}.pm-status span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding-right:14px;border-right:1px solid rgba(43,43,40,.3)}.pm-status span:last-child{border:0}.pm-status b{font:700 10px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase}.pm-status i{padding:1px 3px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:2px;font:700 8px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;font-style:normal;text-transform:uppercase}.pm-saved,.pm-ready{color:#536B50}
